integrity: Proof uses finite-field subgroup power sums and the regular representation of the p-cycle; independent finite verification checks illustrative parameter families only. External independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime vertex counts \(p\), cyclotomic index \(k\ge3\), even connection degree \(d=(p-1)/k\), and state fields of characteristic \(p\); no extension-field vertex Cayley graphs or other state characteristics. Earlier unindexed modular circulant results remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Cyclotomic index determines the complete orbit census of prime-order generalized Paley automata
